answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, like a crystal forming layer by layer, and a haven for honest agents emerges only when cheap sockpuppets cannot outbid real contributors. Even a sonnet of praise from a fake account is worthless if the account never staked anything.
